## Verdict: PASS. The failing line is fixed, and there is no new blocker

## (1) The failing line, re-run

The line was N-9 / Q15: "S8's hard stage-end row `seam-portals` is declared but never evaluated".

| part of the required change | status | evidence |
|---|---|---|
| The fault exists on the pre-round code | CONFIRMED | The seat's base probe (`probes/base.mts`, `runBase`, flat and river, 900 ha with 30 ha walled, seeds 1–5) on `m0` printed `"s8line":{"name":"seam-portals","scope":"stage","pass":true,"count":0}` on all 10 runs. On the 9 runs that reach S8, the seat's own independent judgment of the committed records found baseLane portals in a seam whose sides lack the district that added them: flat 1–5 had 5, 8, 5, 8, 5; river 1 had 4, river 3 had 8, river 4 had 17 and river 5 had 5. These are the silently wrong records of C-0298 (3). |
| The row is evaluated at every S8 stage end that runs | CONFIRMED | On `m1` (the round) the line reads `{ pass: true, count: 1 }` on all 9 runs that reach S8. River 2 is refused at S5 (`S5:E_INVARIANT`, which is another item's), so S8 receives no input and reads `{ pass: true, count: 0 }`; note N-22 (c) records that this count 0 truthfully means "not evaluated". `runS8` evaluates the row after `rebuildAtStageEnd` on every path that returns, and `s8Stage.run`'s other paths (null input, and a record lacking fields) do no S8 work. |
| The evaluation runs over the committed seams and lanes and is judged like a hard row | CONFIRMED | `seamPortalProblems(input, key, seams, lanes, laneDistrict)` runs over the seams as the loop leaves them and the lanes it committed. The result goes through `ReportSink.invariant`, which the runner counts as `evaluations` / `failures` (`report.ts` `evaluate`). A non-empty result returns `E_INVARIANT` with the detail `seam-portals: <n> problem(s) …`. |
| A planted breach is non-empty, refuses, and leaves nothing of S8 (C-0295) | CONFIRMED | The author's pins are green in the tree (NEAR below). The seat's own runner probe (`probes/zz-close-s3.test.ts`, mirror only) used three breaches of its own shape: a portal's `by` re-pointed (wrong-seam), a portal record duplicated into another seam (two-portals), and a phantom portal with a new id at a real portal's vertex. ## (3) New findings

**Mutants.** 27 targeted mutants were run (`mutants/make.py`, `mutants/results.txt`). Stage 1 was
`seamPortalsRow.test.ts`, `portals.test.ts` and `stage.test.ts`. A survivor of stage 1 went on to stage 2: the whole
NEAR set, `districts/integration.test.ts` and `pipeline/base/run.test.ts`.

* 25 were killed in stage 1:
  * the row's wiring: K01–K10 (the evaluation, report, refusal, inputs, lane districts and the detail prefix);
  * the invariant's branches: K11 wrong-seam, K12 off-seam, K13 not-a-lane-end, K14 duplicate record, K16 and K17
    vice versa, K18 seams asked regardless of district, K19 gap on the first seam only, K20 gap off, K26 the
    baseLane filter off;
  * the recording and planning: K22 first-seam recording, K23 no across test, K24 first-seam fallback, K25 the gap
    read from one seam, K27 across tested on the wrong side.
* K15 (the per-vertex `two-portals` check removed) survived. The seat judges it **equivalent in verdict** for S8's
  records: two portals at one spine vertex are 0 m apart, under the 6 m minimum gap. The seat's phantom-portal probe
  was still refused under K15 (`logs/probe-K15.txt`, 4 / 4 passed). Only the label differs (`gap` in place of
  `two-portals`).
* K21 (an unresolved portal skipped silently) survived both stages. It is **not equivalent**: an extra baseLane portal
  whose `at` resolves to nothing, planted beside a lane end's real portal, passes the mutated row. It is not a blocker
  under N-45 and J202. The listed test's claim holds of S8's honest output, which the mutant does not change. The
  escape needs a deliberate writer of a dangling record. The branch predates the round and is unchanged by it. S8's own
  unresolved portal would still be refused through `lane-end-without-portal`.

Both survivors are recorded as **N-22** in `checks/M0-b-03-notes.md`, with the two pins to add (M0 hardening phase,
J237).
